name: Earth
headline: equatorialDiameter
description: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the largest of the rocky (terrestrial) planets. It is slightly flattened, so its equatorial diameter of 12,756 km is a little larger than its pole-to-pole diameter. NASA's fact sheet gives a volumetric mean radius of 6,371 km and a mass of about 5.97 × 10²⁴ kg.

measures.label: Mean radius
measures.note: Volumetric mean radius (mean diameter is twice this)

measures.label: Volume
measures.note: NASA fact sheet lists this as 10^10 km³ units

facts.text: Earth's equatorial radius is 6,378.137 km and its polar radius is 6,356.752 km.
NASA gives Earth's equatorial diameter as 7,926 miles (12,756 kilometers), the biggest of the terrestrial planets.
